note: Work: Employment Act, 2023 (Act No. 15 of 2023, assented 11 May 2023), read on SierraLII, section 95: a child under 15 shall not be employed to perform work in a workplace (any place under an employer's control where workers go by reason of their work); under 18, no underground, night, overtime or harmful work. The section makes no exception for performers; the Minister may by statutory instrument exclude limited categories of work from the age (section 95(7)(c)), and no such instrument was found, so a performer under 15 is held as barred (a reading, not the law's word). The Child Rights Act 2007's rules on light work weren't read (SierraLII's search didn't return it). Majority: not read; no statute setting the age of majority was found on SierraLII. Service: not read; no Sierra Leone law calling anyone to military service was found (the Republic of Sierra Leone Armed Forces Act wasn't returned by SierraLII's search).

sources.title: SierraLII, Employment Act, 2023 (Act No. 15 of 2023)
sources.said: 95. Child labour (1) A child under the age of 15 years shall not be employed to perform work in a workplace . ... “ workplace ” means a place where workers need to be or to go by reason of their work and which is under the direct or indirect control of an employer
